_note: Concept model — the SSOT for the book's core concepts and their site realization. Keyed by the SAME slug as the `- concept:` registry in index-terms.md (the join key). `book_home` is NOT stored here — it is DERIVED at check time from the index-def tags via build_book_html._harvest_concept_tags, so it cannot drift. `name` is likewise DERIVED from the registry, never stored. This file holds ONLY what the registry cannot: the concept's kind, its SITE realization, and its status. A slug here SHOULD be registered in index-terms.md; a slug that is not (or that has no index-def in prose) is a FINDING the four audit-only lints (L1-L4 in tests/html.py) report — the seeding is SUPPOSED to surface gaps, which become the Phase-2 drain worklist. `kind` in {thesis, axis, family, mechanism-class, caveat}; `status` in {both, book-only, site-only, book-expands-site-missing, planned}. Queryable via `catalog.py concepts`.
